attachment-transfer-limits-saved: An adana iyakokin canja wurin maƙala.

attachment-upload-limit-label: Matsakaicin girman fayil na ɗora maƙala
automatic-linked-url-schemes: Tsarukan URL na musamman da ya kamata a danna ta atomatik. Tsarin URL ɗaya a kowane layi
board-creation-admin-only: Kawai masu gudanarwa ne za su iya ƙirƙirar allo
board-view-group-by-assignee: Rukuni bisa ga wanda aka baiwa
board-view-product-backlog: Jerin ayyukan samfur da ake jira
board-view-velocity: Adadin aikin da ake kammalawa a kowane zango
confirm-move-list-to-swimlane: A matsar da wannan jeri da duk katunansa zuwa ɗayan layin iyo?
delete-board-confirm-popup: Za a share dukkan jerin abubuwa, katuna, alamomi da ayyuka, kuma ba za ka iya dawo da abubuwan da ke cikin allon ba. Babu hanyar warwarewa.
drag-to-reorder: Ja don sauya jeri. Maɓallan kibiya sama da ƙasa suna matsar da wuri ɗaya.
enable-permanent-delete: Kunna sharewa ta dindindin ga Babban Mai Gudanarwa
enable-permanent-delete-description: Ba Babban Masu Gudanarwa damar share abun da aka share a laushi har abada. Kunna wannan saitin ba ya share komai da kansa.
external-link-identifier-aliases: Gajerun kalmomi don {identifier}, misali TK=Task, IN=Incident
feature-approval-required: A bar fasalolin da sabuntawar WeKan suka ƙara a kashe har sai mai gudanarwa ya kunna su
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu na allo → Taƙaitawa yana nuna abin da kowa ya yi a kan allo a rana ko mako na ƙarshe, da abin da ya wuce lokaci.
feature-pilot-users: Masu amfani na gwaji waɗanda su ma suna ganin fasalolin da aka kashe
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Sunayen masu amfani, an raba su da waƙafi
feature-pilot-users-unknown: An adana. Ba a sami waɗannan sunayen masu amfani ba:
feature-preview-admins: Masu gudanarwa suna ganin fasalolin da aka kashe don su gwada su da farko
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu na allo → Dokoki suna ba da shawarar dokoki daga abin da mutane ke yi da hannu akai-akai.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Neman duka yana fahimtar jumloli kamar "katunana da suka wuce lokaci" yana mai da su masu aiki.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu na allo → Tun ziyararka ta ƙarshe yana nuna abin da wasu suka canza a kan allo.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalanda da kalandar alluna da yawa.
feature-views-chat-desc: Allon a matsayin wurin hira: wuraren aiki, allunan, layuka, jeri da katuna a matsayin bishiyar tashoshi, katin a tsakiya kuma sharhunansa a matsayin saƙonnin hira.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Katunan iri ɗaya a cikin rukunan ginshiƙai da yawa masu suna - bisa kammalawa, fifiko, muhimmin mataki ko wani abu dabam - ana motsa su tsakanin ginshiƙai ta hanyar ja.
feature-views-email-desc: Allon a matsayin akwatin wasiku: jerin imel shine Akwatin shiga, jeri manyan fayiloli ne, alamomi alamomi ne, kuma mambobi suna rubutawa da amsa imel daga adireshin allon.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Aikin da ya rage da wanda aka gama, tarin gudana, lokacin zagaye da isarwa, yawan aikin da aka gama, tsawon zaman aiki, cikas, Monte Carlo da sauran ma'aunan gudana.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Nau'ukan duba jadawalin Gantt guda uku.
feature-views-map-desc: Katuna a matsayin alamomi a kan hoton da aka ɗora.
feature-views-overview-desc: Ƙididdiga, haɗawa bisa wanda aka ba aiki, taswirar shiri, allon bayani da babban allo.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Jerin ayyukan samfur, zangunan aiki, rahoton zangon aiki da sauri.
feature-views-table-desc: Allo a matsayin tebur na katuna da za a iya jera su.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Allon a matsayin mai bin diddigin batutuwa na GitHub ko Gitea: katuna a matsayin batutuwa, alamomi da matakai, sharhi a matsayin tattaunawa, haɗe-haɗe a matsayin fayiloli, da tarihin allo tare da sokewa.
home-board-empty: Ja allo ɗaya kawai nan don buɗe shi bayan shiga
home-board-remove-confirm: A cire wannan allo daga Gida? Ba za a share allon kansa ba.
multi-selection-active: Danna akwatunan zaɓi don zaɓar alluna
normal-assigned-only: Na yau da kullum ga waɗanda aka ba kawai
password-mismatch: Kalmomin sirri ba su dace ba
r-import-export: Shigo da kaya / Fitar da kaya
select-only-one-board: Don Allah zaɓi allo ɗaya kawai
set-selected-home: Saita a matsayin allon Gida (ana buɗewa bayan shiga)
